item.title: SLCAN (USB to CAN Communication Adapter)
item.description: The DynoSure SLCANv1 adapter provides a reliable and convenient connection between a PC and a CAN(Controller Area Network) bus. It is based on the open-source CANable2 firmware and utilizes the Lawicel SLCAN protocol for serial-line CAN communication. It comes with support for BUSMASTER.

item.title: SLCAN GPIO (USB to CAN Adapter with GPIO)
item.description: The DynoSure SLCAN GPIO adapter provides a reliable and convenient connection between a PC and a CAN(Controller Area Network) bus with additional GPIO (General Purpose Input/Output) capabilities. It is based on the open-source CANable2 firmware and utilizes the Lawicel SLCAN protocol for serial-line CAN communication. It comes with support for BUSMASTER.

item.title: DynoSure LoggerV1 (CAN 2.0B Data Logger)
item.description: The first prototype of our CAN 2.0B Logger (DynoSure LoggerV1) has been successfully tested and verified! Following the successful launch of our first product, the SLCANv1 (a USB-to-CAN tool supporting the widely used BUSMASTER software), we are proud to introduce another essential tool designed specifically for automotive engineering.
